<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

 "problem_statement": "Finance teams rely on consistent numbers between the dashboard and exported files, but discrepancies between them undermine trust in the data. This leads to delays in reporting and uncertainty over which figures are accurate.",
 "similar": [

   "similarity": 0.038,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.\", \"id\": 4136, \"name\": \"Supplier address fields\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {

   "id": "4138",
   "similarity": 0.037,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Configure global settings for your organisation within Keelwater, including default claim categories, notification preferences, and user permissions to ensure consistent workflows across teams.\", \"id\": 4138, \"name\": \"Organisation settings\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4131",

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater's workspace administration feature allows users to manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within their claims environment — all through a centralized, intuitive dashboard.\", \"id\": 4131, \"name\": \"Workspace administration\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Users can navigate through claim reports using intuitive shortcuts, streamlining access to key data without leaving the current view. Keelwater’s interface ensures quick filtering and drill-downs for efficient claim analysis.\", \"id\": 4137, \"name\": \"Reporting navigation\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {

   "similarity": 0.015,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"5d34277f-8ec2-5892-b44d-efd7248786a5\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Reporting navigation\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Reporting navigation\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Users can navigate through reporting sections in Keelwater with a streamlined menu, allowing quick access to claims summaries, analytics, and export options without leaving the current context.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Users can navigate through reporting sections in Keelwater with a streamlined menu, allowing quick access to claims summaries, analytics, and export options without leaving the current context.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\":"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement (dashboard vs. exported-file number discrepancies undermining data trust) against the five similar items. None address data consistency between dashboards and exports: story 4136 covers supplier address formats, 4138 covers organisation settings, 4131 (completed 2026-09-15) covers workspace administration/permissions, 4137 and the Notion page cover reporting navigation. All similarities are very low (max 0.038) and no shipped story or roadmap item tackles this discrepancy problem. The core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
